# Postmortem recipe (summary)

Full recipe: `docs/ARTIFACT_RECIPES.md` (canonical).

`ASSESS` only.

```text
ASSESS:  incident · impact · observed sequence · evidence
         · causal/contributing factors · confidence · detection failures
         · recovery behavior · corrective recommendations
         · unresolved questions
```

Do not force causal certainty. A causal factor with no evidence is
`UNAVAILABLE`; detection failures and recovery behavior are first-class
observations, not narrative color.
